headline: Tabled sewer adjustment requests for 35 View St. and 221 Greene St. until October 2026.
summary: Customers asked for sewer adjustments after high winter quarter reads at 35 View St., Unit B and 221 Greene St., Unit A. Both requests were tabled to October 2026 so procedures for adjusting sewer quarter reads can be re-evaluated. The meeting also approved the August 18, 2026 minutes and the August 2026 department reports.

decision_titles: Sewer adjustment requests for 35 View St. and 221 Greene St.
transcript:
# BOARD OF SEWER COMMISSION
## SEPTEMBER 15, 2026 – REGULAR MEETING

**PRESENT:** Chairperson Phelan; Commissioners Ferrier, Porrini and Cunningham. Council Liaison Peter Kelley.

**PRESENT by videoconference:** Superintendent Longo. Sean Hennessey, Sewer Director

**ABSENT:** Commissioner Dunn.

**STAFF PRESENT:** Assistant Superintendents Pagliaruli, Bolduc, Keegan, and Dawn LaBella, Office Manager.

### 1) CALL TO ORDER.

Chairperson Phelan called the meeting of the Board of Sewer Commission to order at 6:00 p.m.

### 2) PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE.

### 3) MOMENT OF SILENCE.

### 4) APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES OF THE AUGUST 18, 2026 REGULAR MEETING.

On motion of Commissioner Ferrier and seconded; it was unanimously voted to approve the August 18, 2026 regular meeting minutes as presented.
Motion passed.

### 5) APPROVAL OF THE DEPARTMENT REPORTS FOR THE MONTH OF AUGUST 2026.

On motion of Commissioner Porrini and seconded; it was unanimously voted to approve the August 2026 Department Reports as presented.
Motion passed.

### 6) PUBLIC PARTICIPATION.

None.

### 7) CUSTOMER CORRESPONDENCE.

- a. 35 View St., Unit B: Requesting sewer adjustment stemming from a high winter quarter read.
- b. 221 Greene St., Unit A: Requesting sewer adjustment stemming from a high winter quarter read.

Chairperson Phelan requested to table both customer correspondence to the October meeting so the Board can re-evaluate the Procedures on adjusting the sewer quarter reads.

On motion of Commissioner Porrini and seconded; it was unanimously to table 35 View St. and 221 Greene St. to the October 2026 meeting.
Motion passed.

### 8) COMMITTEE REPORTS.

None

### 9) I & I STUDY.

No action taken.

### 10) SUPERINTENDENTS REPORT.

No action taken.

### 11) OLD BUSINESS.

None.

### 12) NEW BUSINESS.

None.

### 13) ADJOURNMENT.

At 6:20 p.m., on motion of Commissioner Porrini and seconded; it was unanimously voted to adjourn.

ATTEST:

Renee M. Ratta
Water & Sewer Administrative Assistant
